settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose which features you need. You can change this anytime — data is not deleted.

settings.featuresHint: Only enabled features appear in the left menu. Turning one off does not delete its data.

items.title: Items & Ingredients
items.subtitle: List everything you buy for the shop — buns, patties, sauce, cups, drinks, all of it.
items.emptyHint: Start with everyday things like buns, patties, and cheese.
items.unitHint: Stock is counted in this unit
items.reorderHint: Alerts when stock falls to this level
items.costHint: Updates automatically when goods are received
items.yieldHint: e.g. 1 kg chicken — if trimming leaves 85%, enter 85

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.subtitle: List what goes into each dish. When you record a sale, ingredients are deducted from stock automatically.
recipes.emptyHint: e.g. Cheese Burger: 1 bun, 1 patty, 1 cheese slice.
recipes.fieldYieldHint: How many portions one batch makes
recipes.fieldPosCatHint: Used as a tab on the order terminal
recipes.fieldIngredientsHint: Enter how much of each item is used
recipes.warnFoodCost: Food cost is above 40%. Consider raising the price or reducing the portion.

purchasing.title: Purchasing
purchasing.subtitle: Suppliers, purchase orders, and goods received (GRN).
purchasing.grnEmptyHint: Record goods when they arrive from a supplier — stock updates automatically.
purchasing.poEmptyHint: You can create a purchase order to send to a supplier.
purchasing.linesHint: Type to search and select items
purchasing.extraCostHint: Allocated across items and added to cost

stock.title: Stock Control
stock.subtitle: See what's on hand right now.
stock.emptyHint: Add items on the Items page and record stock.
stock.fieldReasonHint: So you can review what happened later

wastage.title: Wastage
wastage.subtitle: Record burnt, spoiled, or dropped items. You can't find profit if waste is hidden.
wastage.emptyHint: That's good — but when something is wasted, record it here.

stocktake.title: Stocktake
stocktake.subtitle: Count by hand and compare with the system. Variances show up immediately.
stocktake.emptyHint: Counting at least once a week is a good habit. Theft and mistakes show up fast.
stocktake.lockedSubtitle: This stocktake is approved and locked.
stocktake.openSubtitle: Enter the actual counts. Leave blank to skip an item.
stocktake.approveConfirm: Approving will adjust system stock to your counts. Continue?

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Open the counter terminal to take orders and print bills. Each sale deducts recipe ingredients from stock.
sales.emptyHint: Take an order on the counter terminal, or send sales from an external POS using the API key in Settings.

terminal.noRecipes: Create menu recipes first. Go to the Recipes page.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Pick a date range to view. You can download to Excel too.
reports.disabledHint: Enable more features in Settings to see reports.

users.title: Users & Security
users.subtitle: Control who can do what in the system.
users.permOwner: Full access. Can manage settings and users.
users.permManager: Can approve stock adjustments and stocktakes.
users.permStorekeeper: Goods received, transfers, and adding items.

branches.title: Branches & Locations
branches.subtitle: Where stock is kept — store, freezer, kitchen, bar. Add branches here if you have more than one site.
branches.emptyHint: You need at least one store location.

costing.title: Costing
costing.methodHint: When purchase prices change, item costs update automatically.
costing.varianceHint: The gap between what recipes say you should use and what actually left stock. A large gap may mean over-portioning, waste, or theft.

beverages.title: Beverages
beverages.subtitle: Bottles, cans, and kegs. When you add a drink as an item and tick "This is a beverage", it appears here.
beverages.emptyHint: On the Items page, tick "This is a beverage" when adding a drink.
